sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt/anglers), 3) as avg_yt_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 140 AND fish_date_doy <= 152 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt/anglers), 3) as avg_yt_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 120 AND fish_date_doy < 140 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls LIMIT 40;
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy, ROUND(AVG(yt/anglers), 3) as avg_yt_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 120 AND 152 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC;
SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c FROM pier WHERE ts_doy >= 140 AND ts_doy <= 152 GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT index_id, value FROM climate WHERE avail_doy = 152 ORDER BY index_id;
SELECT report_date_doy, yt_local, yt_all FROM fishdope WHERE report_date_doy >= 145 AND report_date_doy <= 152 ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt/anglers), 3) as avg_ypa FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy IN (144, 147, 151, 152) GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls DESC;
